The '''Mortex sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the planets [[Dakot Seven]], [[Lotide]], and [[Almania]].

==History==
Hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Almanian Uprising]] of [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the sector was [[Almanian sector invasion|invaded]] by an Almanian army [[General/Legends|general]] named [[Kueller (general)|Kueller]].<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> The sector had a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cell established after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Once the Alliance's influence spread across the region, the rebel leader [[Callus]] was appointed its [[Sector Commander|sector commander]].
